posts.title: Change Your Diet Change Your Life
posts.description: Gabriela of Bee a Solution tells her story of getting sick after coming to America, and how she healed by changing what she put in her body. Her bio chemistry background and natural curiosity led her to understand how all the synthetic chemicals in our food and everything else is making people sick, and how to undo this and become well.

posts.title: Holistic Learning – How to Educate Yourself and Others
posts.description: How do we learn, is something outside of us absorbed, or something within drawn out?? Clay Schmitz sits down with Dr. Paul C. Wang of Dao Center in Albany, CA to discuss education and learning.
